outing.hero_prompt_english: Yongding Tower in Mentougou: a tall multilevel Chinese pavilion with stacked tiled eaves, warm timber coloring and an expansive urban riverfront square. The Yongding River and western hills form horizontal layers beyond. An adult strolling at ground level looks toward the tower from the public paved plaza; no climbing or riverside scrambling. Original peaceful full-bleed vertical artwork, layered filled background. No text, letters, logos, copied artwork, or invented maps. Adults in opaque everyday clothes only if people appear.
